'''Denny Borsboom''' (born November 9, 1973) is a Dutch psychologist and psychometrician. He has been a professor of psychology at the [[University of Amsterdam]] since 2013.<ref>[http://albumacademicum.uva.nl/id/id056480 Prof. dr. D. Borsboom, 1973 -] at Album Academicum of the UvA</ref> His work has included applying [[network theory]] to the study of [[mental disorder]]s and their symptoms.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.psychologicalscience.org/publications/observer/obsonline/network-analysis-a-better-way-to-represent-data.html |title=The Many Faces of Network Analysis |date=2011-05-28 |website=Association for Psychological Science Observer |language=en-US |access-date=2017-11-23}}</ref> In 2018 he presented the [[Paul B. Baltes Lecture]] at the [[Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities]]. He was the President of the Psychometric Society between 2024 and 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.psychometricsociety.org/post/past-present-and-incoming-presidents|title=Past, Present, and Incoming Presidents|access-date=2026-01-08}}</ref>
